input.change_text: Security: Bash deny rules now match commands wrapped in `env`/`sudo`/`watch`/`ionice`/`setsid` and similar exec wrappers

output.subject: Bash deny rules now match commands wrapped in env / sudo / watch / ionice / setsid
output.action_text: Upgrade to `claude-code` 2.1.113+ to make Bash deny rules match commands wrapped in `env`, `sudo`, `watch`, `ionice`, `setsid`, and similar exec wrappers. Pre-fix, a denied command ran when prefixed by any common exec wrapper — e.g. `Bash(curl:*)` deny was bypassed by `env curl ...`.
